verdict.rationale: ClickUp's docs say the OpenAPI spec is published "for each version of our Public API", which implies the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, and the probe found no spec at the standard well-known paths. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit version scheme and lifecycle/sunset documentation, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.
